constraints: Use exactly the gene set retained by the T1S1 filter so the two methods are compared on identical features

steps.name: Preranked gene-set enrichment of the treated-vs-control signature
caveats: With 3 vs 3 the ranking itself is noisy, so GSEA results inherit that noise; NES magnitudes should be reported with their adjusted p-values and not narrated as mechanism
GO BP sets are nested and produce blocks of correlated hits — collapse redundant parent/child sets before quoting a count of significant pathways
A 12,000-gene matrix is a filtered/subset transcriptome, so the GSEA universe is smaller than a full annotation; report the matched fraction so the reader can judge coverage
steps.context: Human liver, drug treatment. The gene symbols in counts.csv are HGNC, so they join directly to the human symbol GMTs. Preranked GSEA is the appropriate primary method here because a 3-vs-3 contrast may yield too few FDR-significant genes for a meaningful over-representation test; GSEA uses the whole ranking and is not thresholded.
steps.question: Which hallmark processes, GO biological processes, and curated pathways are coordinately shifted in drug-treated human liver relative to control, including any xenobiotic-metabolism, drug-response or hepatotoxicity-associated programmes?
constraints: Use the human (HGNC symbol) gene-set collections — the mouse and rat GMTs in the environment must not be used on this Homo sapiens dataset
Do not use the DESeq2 log2 fold change alone as the ranking metric; use the test statistic so significance and direction are both encoded
Report adjusted p-values; enrichment reported at nominal p only must be labelled as such
Do not interpret a leading-edge gene list as evidence of pathway activation — describe it as a coordinated expression shift
steps.description: Take the FULL ranked DESeq2 results table from T1S2 (not a thresholded list) and run preranked GSEA with fgsea. Rank genes by the Wald statistic (or by -log10(p) * sign(shrunken LFC) if the statistic is unavailable), dropping genes with NA adjusted p-values and resolving any remaining duplicate symbols by keeping the most extreme statistic. Gene identifiers are already HGNC symbols, matching the gene-set files directly — no ID conversion needed. Required reference data: human hallmark gene sets, human GO biological process gene sets, and human WikiPathways gene sets — all three are HGNC-symbol GMT collections and all three are present in this environment; resolve them at run time rather than hard-coding, and if any one is missing, run the remaining collections and report which was unavailable. Restrict to sets of size 15-500, use at least 10,000 permutations (nPermSimple/eps set for stable small p-values), and report BH-adjusted p-values per collection separately. Emit per-collection tables (pathway, size, ES, NES, pval, padj, leading-edge genes) and figures: NES bar plot of the top 15 up and top 15 down significant sets per collection, and enrichment-score curves for the top 5. Separately, if T1S2 yielded at least 25 genes at padj<0.05, additionally run an over-representation test (clusterProfiler enrichGO on BP, and a hypergeometric test against hallmark and WikiPathways) using the tested-and-filtered gene set as the universe, and report it beside the GSEA. Given the liver tissue and drug-treatment context, explicitly check and report the position of xenobiotic/drug-metabolism, bile-acid, fatty-acid-metabolism, oxidative-stress and inflammatory-response sets in the ranking whether or not they reach significance, so an absence of a drug-response signature is reported rather than left silent.
acceptance_criteria: Preranked GSEA is run on the full ranked gene list, not a thresholded subset, and the ranking metric used is stated

Human hallmark, GO BP, and WikiPathways human collections are each tested, with the FDR correction applied within each collection separately; any collection that could not be resolved is named in the output
Result tables include NES, adjusted p-value, set size and the leading-edge gene symbols for every tested set
The fraction of ranked genes that matched each collection is reported (symbol-matching sanity check)
Xenobiotic/drug-metabolism, bile-acid, fatty-acid-metabolism, oxidative-stress and inflammatory-response sets are reported with their NES and adjusted p-value regardless of significance
ORA is run only if >=25 genes reach padj<0.05, and when run uses the filtered tested genes as the universe; otherwise its omission is stated

plan.title: Liver drug-treated vs control DE (3v3, STAR/featureCounts)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a raw integer gene-level count matrix from STAR + featureCounts (/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv, 12,000 genes x 6 sample columns, first column HGNC gene symbol) with a 6-row sample table (/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv) giving a single `condition` factor: 3 treated vs 3 control human liver samples, unpaired, single batch. Because these are integer counts from a genomic aligner and not transcript-level abundance estimates, the correct entry point is a negative-binomial count model applied directly to the matrix — no tximport, no length-offset, no effective-length correction. DESeq2's median-of-ratios normalization is appropriate here (featureCounts values are not length-normalized, and library-size normalization is all that is needed for a within-gene between-sample contrast).

Step T1S1 does QC and normalization: symbol-duplicate resolution, low-count filtering, VST, library-size and sample-correlation diagnostics, and PCA — the essential check that the 3-vs-3 split is the dominant source of variance and that no single sample is an outlier, which matters enormously at n=3 per group where one aberrant replicate can drive the whole result. T1S2 runs the DESeq2 Wald test for treated vs control with control as reference, apeglm-shrunken LFCs for ranking, and produces the ranked DE table plus volcano/MA/heatmap. T1S3 is a robustness check with edgeR quasi-likelihood on the same filtered matrix: with n=3 per group the dispersion estimate is fragile and a concordance check between two independent NB frameworks is the cheapest available guard against a method-specific artefact — no external replication cohort exists here. T1S4 takes the full ranked statistic into a pathway layer (fgsea preranked on human hallmark, GO BP, and WikiPathways human gene sets, all present under /mnt/refs), which is preferred over an ORA on a possibly-tiny significant-gene list; ORA is run alongside only if the DE list is large enough to support it.

The design is minimal: 3 vs 3, unpaired, one batch, no covariates to model, so the design is simply ~condition. Power is low and the plan says so explicitly in the acceptance criteria — every step must report effect sizes and counts rather than assert biology, and if the DE result is empty at FDR 0.05 that is to be reported as an underpowered negative, not rescued by loosening thresholds.
